dialogue_texts: It appears the boundary of this festive chaos has finally been mended. Cleaning up after foolish children always bores me.
What is it, little Kotori? Oh, my. Look at you. Aren't you looking exceptionally proper and poised for a little crow tengu?
I went and got a formal makeover for the festival. Even for my age, I absolutely loved it, and so do my parents.
A grand festival requires a proper display of elegance, after all. When a mundane choice just won't suffice, shifting boundaries to don a brilliant outfit is a magnificent change of pace.
Come on down, My Majesty! You're missing the best stuff. I decided to try on hanfu instead of my shrine maiden robes. When I dress in hanfu, I feel confident.
I'm dressed as an oiran performer, yet I still wear Western imperial robes.
I'm doing the same as Koko. It makes me feel like the most handsome person in Mayohiga.
Flower viewing in such exotic garments almost makes me feel I've wandered into a mythical boutique on the far continent.
Now that the glohm is gone and with the festival in full swing, I can finally dress up as the true Herald of Autumn!
Watching the borders of time blur as everyone revives ancient aesthetics feels like a magnificent historical wave sweeping through us.
I'm sure there's a ball going on in the Kozankyo Imperial Palace. I need to find a man to dance with!
I won't hesitate to meet with King Kourin, but I should go check on Hiroyuki and Fusana...
Oh, my. What an exquisite alignment of stars. It is truly marvelous to see the master of the manor and his precious servant reunited within the same boundaries once more.
Like in the nights before the glohm took hold of me, Hiroyuki and I have spent the past few hours dancing to keep our romance together.
When I need to dance, I just rely on the duke who acts as a stand-in for King Kourin.
I find coming back to the standard waltz again and again satisfying after a full day's worth of work. Our partnership is going to level up a whole tier shortly.
What are you going to do?
After everything that we've been through, I think it's time for the two of us to get married and start a family.
Are you going to give me that ring?
Yes, I will. Mind if you take off your right glove for a few moments?

I had to cross the boundaries to the Shirogane Manor twice just to restore proper order to your future bride's mind. Therefore, you two should organize the most magnificent wedding in Gensokyo's history!
And so, Hiroyuki and Fusana prepare to spend the rest of their lives as a married couple and eventual family, and they promise to attend the Kozankyo Autumn Equinox Festival year after year.
The story of the Glohm Incident has come to a close. The Kirisame Dynasty Saga continues in Touhou Kichouden ~ Mythos of Phantasmagoria 2.
